text:
Owen: heads-up, promote paused by deploy-bot — manifest verification failed with content-encoding mismatch, holding the cut.
Priya: can you paste the deploy-bot output?
Owen: sure, snippet below:
```
deploy-bot: promo job=promo-2026-03-22-ff
registry: fetched manifest sha256:cc33...77
layer-verify: layer index=2 expected-digest=sha256:aa22...bb encoded=true
blob-fetch: served-content-encoding=identity content-length=4123400
storage-verify: computed-digest=sha256:dd44...99 != expected-digest
deploy-bot: manifest verification failed: content-encoding mismatch (manifest expects gzip-encoded blob)
deploy-bot: ACTION=PAUSE promotion paused until manual resume
```
Marta: interesting — manifest claims the blob is gzip-encoded, but the blob served with no gzip header. Could be a CDN edge stripping Content-Encoding on ranged GETs or an S3 upload without content-encoding header.
registry-bot: scan report: object 2026.03.22/asset.tar.gz was uploaded with Content-Encoding=gzip by CI at 02:08 UTC. CDN edge mirror mep-12 reported `Content-Encoding` removed for range requests between 02:20-02:35 UTC due to bug in our edge proxy when `Accept-Encoding` present.
Priya: ops, any recent CDN edge config changes?
ops-bot: We rolled a tiny patch to edge-proxy on mep-12 at 02:19 that touched range handling. No bucket or origin changes. Rollback not yet triggered.
Marta: options: (1) force-promo pin to origin digest (bypass content-encoding check) and resume now, (2) invalidate CDN + repush artifact ensuring Content-Encoding persists, then resume after cross-region verify, (3) rollback candidate.
Owen: product says no strict SLA for this internal infra release. I'd prefer safety. Option 2.
Priya: Agreed. If we repush, add explicit Content-Encoding header in the manifest and verify via origin and a couple of mirrors before resuming. Also add a promo guard to prefer origin-verified blobs.
Marta: I'll kick a republish job with `ci/publish --release 2026.03.22 --force-encoding=gzip --verify-origin` and queue CDN invalidation for mep-12.
Owen: deploy-bot: promotion remains paused. Manual resume requires checksum+encoding match.
Marta: republish started. Logs: `upload part 1..6`, `complete multipart`, `set Content-Encoding=gzip -> 201`
registry-bot: cross-region verify: origin eu-west OK (encoding=gzip), us-east OK, mep-12 cached edge still returning identity for range requests but after invalidation it's pulling from origin and now returns gzip.
Priya: staging/canary re-smoke kicked automatically on new manifest.
ops-bot: flagging an incident for edge-proxy regression mep-12-2026-03-22; rolling back patch to mep-12 for investigation.
Owen: staging/canary smoke passed. Checksums and headers consistent. Ready to resume in 3m.
Marta: resuming promotion now. deploy-bot: promotion resumed by Marta (reason=republish+verify). Running final manifest+encoding verification... OK.
deploy-bot: promotion completed, release 2026.03.22 cut successfully.
Priya: nice coordination — please add a short note in the release notes: "Republished artifacts to enforce Content-Encoding persistence; fixed CDN edge proxy range handling; cross-region verifies added to promotion flow."
Marta: Created follow-up ticket ENGR-3142 to add origin-first verify to deploy pipeline and ENGINFRA-514 for edge-proxy rollback investigation.
Owen: thanks all — closing thread. :tada:
